how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-orgrimmar-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7835:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦1⟧!
rows.quest:7836:completion:0: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.
rows.quest:7836:completion:1: BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
rows.quest:7926:obj:0: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.
rows.quest:7926:details:0: The Darkmoon Faire is coming! Be sure to experience all the wonders and excitement of it when it comes to town!
rows.quest:7926:details:1: BIf you act right now, you can redeem this voucher for free prize tickets! Just hand your voucher to Gelvas Grimgate located inside the carnival.
rows.quest:7926:details:2: BRight now, the Faire is just outside ⟦E1⟧, in ⟦E2⟧. Don't miss out! Go today!
rows.quest:7926:completion:0: Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire! This voucher is good for FIVE, yes, FIVE prize tickets!
rows.quest:7926:completion:1: BWhen you accumulate prize tickets, you'll want to speak to me about redeeming them for valuable prizes. The more tickets you get, the more prizes you can win. Huzzah!
rows.quest:8276:obj:0: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8276:details:0: Attention, champions of the ⟦E4⟧! There's a threat we've left unchallenged for too long. Tremors in the earth near silithid hives all around ⟦E5⟧ have alerted us to large movements in their numbers as they prepare for expansion.
rows.quest:8276:details:1: BCenarion Circle forces are gathering in ⟦E3⟧ to take the fight to the silithid before it's too late! No more shall they defile our lands!
rows.quest:8276:details:2: BAll able-bodied combatants are to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold! The silithid shall be vanquished!
rows.quest:8276:completion:0: Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. Welcome to Cenarion Hold, ⟦2⟧. I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.
rows.quest:8367:obj:0: Bring 3 ⟦E6⟧ Marks of Honor, 3 ⟦E7⟧ Marks of Honor and 3 ⟦E8⟧ Marks of Honor to a ⟦E4⟧ Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8367:details:0: Serving the ⟦E4⟧ in one of the great battles against the ⟦E9⟧ is a source of great honor! The few however, that have served the ⟦E4⟧ in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters. We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.
rows.quest:8367:details:1: BGo forth and crush the ⟦E9⟧ in ⟦E7⟧, ⟦E6⟧, Eye of the Storm and ⟦E8⟧! For Honor! For the ⟦E4⟧!
rows.quest:8367:completion:0: Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. Part with past tokens of victory, ⟦3⟧. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. Stand up straight, ⟦4⟧. Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!
rows.quest:8913:obj:0: Acquire 15 ⟦E3⟧ Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Mokvar in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:8913:details:0: Hail, ⟦5⟧! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
rows.quest:8913:details:1: BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
rows.quest:8913:details:2: BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit ⟦E3⟧. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
rows.quest:8913:completion:0: Ah, yes. Mux will be quite happy with this.
rows.quest:8913:completion:1: BThose bracers were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

rows.quest:8927:details:0: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, ⟦19⟧. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
rows.quest:8927:details:1: BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.

rows.quest:8957:obj:0: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
rows.quest:8957:details:0: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.
rows.quest:8957:details:1: BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
rows.quest:8957:details:2: BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
rows.quest:8957:completion:0: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
rows.quest:8957:completion:1: BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.
rows.quest:8978:obj:0: Return to Mokvar in ⟦E10⟧ with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.
rows.quest:8978:details:0: It's been great working with you, ⟦30⟧. Here is the finished product.
rows.quest:8978:details:1: BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
rows.quest:8978:completion:0: You've returned with the device! I'm impressed by your dedication, ⟦31⟧. Excellent work.
rows.quest:8998:obj:0: Speak with Mokvar at Grommash Hold in ⟦E10⟧'s Valley of Wisdom.
rows.quest:8998:details:0: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:8998:details:1: BGo, before I start to cry. Go back to Mokvar in ⟦E10⟧ and tell him what's happened.
rows.quest:8998:completion:0: I am pleased to see that you have survived, ⟦32⟧. You look well, if not a bit more seasoned.
rows.quest:8998:completion:1: BCome, tell me of all that has transpired.
rows.quest:9007:obj:0: Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
rows.quest:9007:details:0: A truly amazing story, ⟦33⟧! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
rows.quest:9007:details:1: BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
rows.quest:9007:completion:0: I will truly miss you, ⟦34⟧. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
rows.quest:9007:completion:1: BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

rows.quest:9017:obj:0: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
rows.quest:9017:details:0: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.
rows.quest:9017:details:1: BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
rows.quest:9017:details:2: BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
